answer: Make new identities earn weight slowly, like a cedar seedling: an account's say in grading grows only with consecutive epochs of peer-attested work and decays if it goes silent. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand wallets at dawn, but each starts with near-zero influence, so flooding a panel is like piling sand on a dune the next wind flattens. Patience becomes the scarce input attackers cannot fake cheaply.
